title: Playgrounds get clearer errors and less waiting
summary:
Chat gained a repetition control, playgrounds got less cryptic, and three community projects joined the directories.

Text and image playgrounds now distinguish denied requests, rate limits and other failures. Image generation retries rate-limited requests when a retry delay is available. Hello also makes unavailable models easier to identify, labels video output separately, and runs theme design, copy and background requests in parallel instead of spacing them 75 seconds apart.

Chat completions gained a `repetition_penalty` parameter with values from 0 to 2. Seedream 4.5 Pro now passes the requested seed to its provider, while a cached-token usage fix prevents some `gemini-large` requests from failing.

The dashboard can once again retrieve and copy full publishable keys. New keys use `pk_` and `sk_` prefixes, and key previews show their beginning rather than their suffix. Pricing and key tooltips now respond to hover on desktop and taps on touch devices, without appearing above key dialogs.

highlights.title: Tune text repetition
highlights.text: Use `repetition_penalty` in chat completion requests to adjust repetition, with values from 0 to 2. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Theme generation skips the queue
highlights.text: Hello now generates theme design, copy and backgrounds in parallel instead of spacing publishable-key requests 75 seconds apart.
